report: Absolute-path release gate exception registry (exact-path, auditable)
policy: exact-path, reason-specific, auditable exceptions; anything not listed fails closed; every exception is a diagnostic record that necessarily QUOTES the machine paths it measured (the scanner-output self-exclusion principle documented in the forensics tool and the rebuild round)

exceptions.reason: captured pytest terminal output from the fresh 2026-09-18 hardening-baseline run (machine-parsed counts are authoritative in baseline_manifest.json / test_summary.json; this textual capture quotes the authoring interpreter's module discovery paths and pytest tmp dirs)
read-only forensic inventory; every finding RECORDS the original machine-local value it measured — quoting is the tool's function (the inventory cannot audit its own pre-measurement state)
read-only path inventory (UPDATE-V2 flow); records original values per task-book taxonomy — same quoting principle
semantic diff report; every change entry carries before/after pairs where 'before' is the original machine-local value being normalized — quoting is the verification mechanism
the gate's own report quotes the violations it measured (excerpt lines); a report cannot audit its own pre-measurement state — same self-exclusion principle as the forensics output directory
two-phase rebuild working-area failure log quoting the failing file path in its diagnostic message (staging is excluded from the release ZIP by policy)
